IMPORTANT: do NOT write the numeric digits 1.5 or 1,5 in this green row at all. The words 'decimal dot' spell out the successful condition unambiguously. The RED Failed row must remain exactly as before, showing input 1,5 → NaN. Preserve proportions and all other screenshot content. This is a surgical text correction, no redesign.
